_comment: Template configuration for the Copious default CV template. This drives both the template-builder UI (P1) and render-time validation.
name: Copious Default
description: Standard Copious branded CV template with cover page, running header, and all sections.
_notes: template.docx is the actual Word file with {{ }} placeholders — author in Word/Google Docs.
See docs/cv_schema_template_mapping.md §4 for the full placeholder reference.
The template.docx file is NOT committed to git (it is gitignored as it may contain candidate PII during development).
Place your template.docx in this directory after cloning. A sample template with placeholders only (no PII) is provided as template-sample.docx.
